reuse.why: Follows the existing hasSavedTemplates/getFillableCategories pattern, but writes its own #fixed regex instead of using the tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText), with different case and delimiter rules from how tags are recognised elsewhere.

duplication.why: The predicate is defined once, but the LEFT JOIN notes / group_note column is added to two separate queries and the skip check is written at two call sites.

placement.why: The rule sits in server/budget/actions.ts next to hasSavedTemplates and inside the existing fillable-category selection and the copyPreviousMonth loop.

scope.why: Only the fixed-group exclusion; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Small and readable with a named predicate; the private tag regex could drift from the app's tag semantics, and the two selection paths remain separate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: FIXED_TAG regex in server/budget/actions.ts re-implements tag detection that shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText) already provides.

disguised_duplication.where: The group-notes join in getBudgetData and getFillableCategories is repeated openly, not disguised.

one_place.where: isFixedGroup in server/budget/actions.ts is the single definition; both month-wide paths (getFillableCategories, used by setZero/avg/last-month actions, and copyPreviousMonth) call it, though each path still applies it at its own check.
